title: David Spares Saul’s Life

questions.question: Where did Saul seek David with 3,000 men?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:1-2 (ESV): “...‘Behold, David is in the wilderness of Engedi.’ Then Saul took three thousand chosen men... to seek David...”

questions.question: What did David do when Saul entered the cave where David was hiding?
options: Cut off a corner of Saul’s robe
questions.correctAnswer: Cut off a corner of Saul’s robe
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:4 (ESV): “...Then David arose and stealthily cut off a corner of Saul’s robe.”

questions.question: Why did David not kill Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:6 (ESV): “...‘The Lord forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the Lord’s anointed, to put out my hand against him...’”

questions.question: How did Saul react when David showed him the robe?
options: He wept and said David was more righteous than him
questions.correctAnswer: He wept and said David was more righteous than him
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:16-17 (ESV): “...Saul lifted up his voice and wept. He said to David, ‘You are more righteous than I, for you have repaid me good, whereas I have repaid you evil.’”

questions.question: What did Saul acknowledge about David’s future?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:20 (ESV): “And now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.”

questions.question: Saul went to look for David near the ______?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:2 (ESV): "...in front of the Rocks of the Wild Goats."

questions.question: Why did Saul go into the cave?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:3 (ESV): "...Saul went in to relieve himself."

questions.question: How did David's conscience react after cutting the robe?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:5 (ESV): "And afterward David's heart struck him, because he had cut off a corner of Saul's robe."

questions.question: David called himself a dead dog and a ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:14 (ESV): "...After a dead dog! After a flea!"

questions.question: What oath did David swear to Saul?
options: Not to cut off his offspring or destroy his name
questions.correctAnswer: Not to cut off his offspring or destroy his name
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:21-22 (ESV): "...Swear to me... that you will not cut off my offspring after me... And David swore this to Saul."

questions.question: Who did David plead to judge between him and Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:12 (ESV): "May the LORD judge between me and you... but my hand shall not be against you."

questions.question: What proverb of the ancients did David quote?
options: Out of the wicked comes wickedness
questions.correctAnswer: Out of the wicked comes wickedness
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:13 (ESV): "As the proverb of the ancients says, 'Out of the wicked comes wickedness.' But my hand shall not be against you."

questions.question: Where were David's men hiding in the cave?
options: In the innermost parts of the cave
questions.correctAnswer: In the innermost parts of the cave
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:3 (ESV): "Now David and his men were sitting in the innermost parts of the cave."

questions.question: Did Saul return home after this encounter?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:22 (ESV): "Then Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold."

questions.question: Saul said, "Is this your voice, my son ______?"
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 24:16 (ESV): "...Is this your voice, my son David?..."

key_verse_text: He said to his men, “The LORD forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, the LORD’s anointed, to put out my hand against him, seeing he is the LORD’s anointed.” (ESV)
